subject: [PATCH v2 2/8] NFSD: cap the number of listeners accepted in listener_set

2026-08-11.patch_summary: This patch limits the number of listeners accepted in a single request to NFSD_NL_LISTENER_MAX (1024) to prevent userland requests from spinning for a long time under atomic context. The existing listener count is not capped, as adding new listeners via write_ports() costs real sockets and is resource-bound. This change improves performance by capping the number of iterations in the nested loop that matches each requested listener against the existing set.
